text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One night, when the dorm had fallen quiet—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Common spiderwort☆! (Tradescantia ohiensis!)
Mirror, mirror, give me an answer!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
My magic skills are improving!
My times are getting better, and I've learned tons of new spells too—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Argh! Geez!! Mirror, you stupid, stupid jerk!
Say something already!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Grrr~~... Are you saying
my magical power still isn't enough...?!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fine! Mirror, mirror, just you watch!
I'll march straight down the path of becoming a Great Witch to the very end!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna become a great witch just like Grandma
and leave you with your jaw hanging wide open!
To do that—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Listen up! Starting today,
we're doing the training *I* want to do!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Training that'll give me a whole bunch of
the magic power the current me needs!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I am ab-so-lute-ly NOT doing any other training!
Got it, familiar!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Missing out on the scheduled training hurts.
Still... I don't want to dismiss her motivation.
Let's follow her menu for a little while!"
